confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Icelandic price levels, with no live listings checked. Restaurant and alcohol anchors are moderately confident because Iceland's price levels are consistently high. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July peak-season rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX observation came from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates overview page, which I did not open directly. A third-party OFX historical figure for 15 October 2026 (0.695572) is consistent with it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Nordic capital price levels (for example Oslo and Copenhagen), adjusted for Iceland's high restaurant and alcohol costs and July tourist-season accommodation demand.
